landmarks.name: Angkor Wat
landmarks.writeup: A massive 12th-century temple complex in Siem Reap, Angkor Wat is the largest religious monument in the world and a symbol of Cambodia.

landmarks.name: Royal Palace, Phnom Penh
landmarks.writeup: The official residence of the King of Cambodia, featuring classic Khmer architecture and beautiful gardens.

landmarks.name: Tuol Sleng Genocide Museum
landmarks.writeup: A former high school turned prison during the Khmer Rouge regime, now a museum documenting the atrocities.

landmarks.name: Koh Ker
landmarks.writeup: An ancient temple complex in northern Cambodia, known for its remote location and unique pyramid-shaped temple.

landmarks.name: Tonle Sap Lake
landmarks.writeup: Southeast Asia's largest freshwater lake, vital for Cambodia's fishing industry and biodiversity.

cultural_events.name: Khmer New Year
cultural_events.writeup: Celebrated in April, marking the traditional solar new year with games, dances, and religious ceremonies.

cultural_events.name: Pchum Ben
cultural_events.writeup: A 15-day religious festival honoring deceased ancestors with offerings at pagodas.

cultural_events.name: Water Festival (Bon Om Touk)
cultural_events.writeup: A November festival celebrating the end of the rainy season with boat races and illuminated floats.

food_writeup: Cambodian cuisine features a balance of sweet, sour, salty, and bitter flavors, with staples like rice, freshwater fish, and herbs. Popular dishes include Amok (steamed fish curry) and Kuy Teav (noodle soup).
brief_history: Cambodia has a rich history dating back to the Khmer Empire (9th-15th centuries), known for its architectural achievements. It experienced French colonial rule from the 19th century until 1953. The country suffered under the Khmer Rouge regime (1975-1979), which caused massive loss of life. Cambodia has since been rebuilding and developing as a constitutional monarchy.

important_people.name: Norodom Sihanouk
important_people.description: Former King and influential political figure

current_conflicts: Cambodia currently experiences no active armed conflicts but faces political tensions related to governance, human rights, and land disputes.
